name: Source Components of a Representation USO Can Be Deleted
statement: Let $C$ be ample, let $r$ be a representation map, and orient its one-inclusion graph by the corresponding unique-sink orientation. For every source strongly connected component $S$, the deletion $C\setminus S$ is ample and the restriction of $r$ is again a representation map.
proof: This is the source-component deletion theorem for representation orientations. No arc enters $S$, so restricting the map after deleting the whole component preserves the representation conditions and the unique-sink property on every remaining cube.
